name: Baseus Power Bank Adaman 22.5w 20000Mah 3 month warrenty
description:
Baseus Power Bank Adaman 22.5W 20000mAh – Metal Digital Display Quick Charge 3 months warrenty

Key Features:

Brand: Baseus

Capacity: 20,000mAh (long-lasting power backup)

Fast Charging: PD 3.0 + QC 3.0 two-way quick charge

Display: LED digital display for real-time battery status

Output Power: 22.5W Huawei SuperCharge | 18W PD charging for iPhones

Multi-Device Charging: 3 inputs & 3 outputs for simultaneous charging

Design: Stylish alloy-plated shell with metallic luster finish

Recharge Time: Fully recharges in approx. 4–6 hours with QC cable

Why Choose This Power Bank?
This 20000mAh Baseus Adaman Power Bank is the perfect choice if you need reliable backup power for multiple devices. With its 22.5W high-power output, it supports Huawei SuperCharge and also delivers fast PD charging for iPhones and Android devices. The durable metallic body, quick recharge support, and digital battery display make it both practical and stylish.
